") center 24%/cover;box-shadow:0 28px 70px #000c,inset 0 0 0 3px #e6ad5b,inset 0 0 100px #0008}
.stage:before{inset:0 0 51%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#510d16bb 0%,transparent 18%,transparent 82%,#510d16bb 100%);opacity:1;pointer-events:none}
.stage:after{content:'✦  ✧  ✦  ✧  ✦';position:absolute;top:6px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:16px;letter-spacing:24px;color:#ffdb7e;text-shadow:0 0 12px #f9aa31;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}
.board{height:53%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 36%,#9c2527 0%,#6a151b 48%,#3a1016 72%,#24100d 74%,#643719 80%,#28150b 100%);border-top:14px ridge #bd8140;box-shadow:0 -14px 35px #000b,inset 0 0 0 9px #6a361b,inset 0 0 0 13px #d9a257,inset 0 0 70px #0009}
.board:after{content:'✧';position:absolute;top:22%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-size:clamp(95px,16vw,210px);color:#f3ba5c20;pointer-events:none}
.message{top:13%;left:50%;right:auto;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(84%,700px);padding:13px 24px;border:2px solid #e7b769;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(#432313ed,#1b0d0bed);color:#ffe5ae;font-size:clamp(1rem,2.3vw,1.55rem);box-shadow:0 9px 24px #0009,inset 0 0 0 2px #724821;text-shadow:0 2px 3px #000}
.bulbs{top:20px;z-index:2}.bulbs i{width:10px;height:10px;background:#ffdf8c;box-shadow:0 0 10px 4px #ffb43eaa}
.cups{z-index:4}.cup{width:clamp(56px,12vw,138px);height:clamp(100px,13vw,158px);z-index:3;filter:drop-shadow(0 13px 6px #000a);transition:filter .18s;user-select:none}
.cup .shape{height:79%;width:90%;clip-path:polygon(26% 2%,74% 2%,97% 97%,3% 97%);background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4a0c13 0%,#871e26 12%,#c7403c 29%,#f07855 43%,#b52d30 61%,#77131f 81%,#410b13 100%);border:0;box-shadow:inset 0 12px 16px #ffcc8240}
.cup .shape:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:17%;right:17%;top:3%;height:12%;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(#ffda81,#9d5c25);box-shadow:0 3px 3px #3a160b}
.cup .shape:after{content:'♢';top:24%;font-size:clamp(29px,5vw,56px);font-weight:bold;color:#ffe3a0;text-shadow:0 0 2px #fff4bd,2px 3px 3px #49180b}
.cup .rim{height:16px;background:linear-gradient(#ffe2a2 0%,#dba452 35%,#874519 80%,#f2b65b);box-shadow:0 5px 7px #000a,0 -5px 0 #f5bc6b70}
.cup .num{display:none!important}.cup{backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}.cup:disabled{opacity:1}.cup:not(:disabled):active{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 16px #ffd775)}
.cup.active{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 20px #ffe98b)}.cup:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffe9a5;outline-offset:4px}
.ball{z-index:12;width:clamp(42px,6vw,62px);height:clamp(42px,6vw,62px);border:3px solid #fff0aa;background:radial-gradient(circle at 29% 23%,#fff 0%,#fff9d2 12%,#ffe45c 30%,#f5aa12 63%,#a74a06 100%);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #fff3ad44,0 0 25px 12px #ffd54aaa,0 13px 13px #0008;pointer-events:none;animation:ballGlow 1.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes ballGlow{from{filter:brightness(1)}to{filter:brightness(1.22)}}
.score{margin:14px 0;gap:12px}.player{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#4c2416f5,#24151cf5);border:2px solid #b78343;border-radius:13px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #603a21,0 8px 20px #0007;text-align:center}.player.current{border-color:#ffe4a1;box-shadow:0 0 22px #e8b05a88}.player .name{color:#ffe0a3;font-size:1.05rem}.player .points{font-size:1.7rem}.player small{color:#e2c6a1}
.btn{background:linear-gradient(#ffe4a2,#d99b46 60%,#a96829);border:2px solid #ffe2a2;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #623819,0 8px 20px #0008;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.12rem}
.setup{padding:12px;background:#25150fd9;border:1px solid #9e713e;border-radius:12px;width:fit-content;margin:12px auto}.setup select{background:#3a2017;border-color:#d7a15a}
.result{background:linear-gradient(#4c2c17,#24120d);border:3px ridge #e0ac59;box-shadow:0 10px 25px #0009}.muted{color:#ffe3bb;text-shadow:0 2px 4px #000}
@media(max-width:650px){.app{padding:9px}.top{padding:9px}.stage{height:390px;border-width:4px}.message{top:16%;width:94%;padding:9px 6px}.board{height:53%}.cup{height:95px;width:clamp(50px,17vw,84px)}.cup .shape:after{font-size:27px}.cup .rim{height:12px}.score{gap:6px}.player{padding:8px 4px}.player .name{font-size:.85rem}.player .points{font-size:1.2rem}.stage:after{display:none}}

/* Premium v2.1: bessere Orientierung, Toucheingabe und animierte Hütchen */
.stage-info{position:absolute;z-index:8;top:66px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:7px 18px;background:rgba(28,13,12,.82);border:1px solid #c99a57;border-radius:999px;color:#ffe6a5;font-size:clamp(11px,1.7vw,15px);font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none}.cup{touch-action:manipulation;margin-top:0!important;will-change:left;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 7px #160a0a99)}.cup:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #ffe392;outline-offset:8px}.cup:disabled{cursor:default}.player.current{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ffd273,0 0 26px #ffd27355}.btn{touch-action:manipulation}.stage{isolation:isolate}@media(max-width:640px){.app{padding:10px 8px 22px}.stage{min-height:320px}.stage-info{top:75px}.cup{scale:.85}.score{gap:6px}.player{min-width:0}.title{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,6vw,2.5rem)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cup{filter:none}}

/* V2.5: alle Hütchen bleiben exakt auf derselben Tischlinie; keine Identifikationsmarker */
.cup{margin:0!important;scale:1!important;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:filter .15s!important;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.cup .shape:after{content:'✦'!important}
.cup .num{display:none!important}
.ball{width:clamp(34px,4vw,52px)!important;height:clamp(34px,4vw,52px)!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #fff3bd44,0 0 22px 9px #ffcf52aa,0 5px 13px #000b!important;z-index:3}
.cup{z-index:4}
.cup.active{z-index:5}
@media(max-width:650px){.cup{scale:1!important}.ball{width:36px!important;height:36px!important}}
</style></head><body><main class="app"><header class="top"><div><div class="badge">JAHRMARKT · MINISPIEL</div><h1 class="title">🎩 Hütchen-Challenge</h1></div><div class="round" id="roundLabel">3 RUNDEN</div></header><section class="stage" aria-label="Hütchenspiel"><div class="bulbs" id="bulbs"></div><div class="stage-info" id="stageInfo">3 Runden · Goldene Kugel</div><div class="message" id="message" role="status" aria-live="polite">Merke dir, unter welchem Hütchen die Kugel liegt!</div><div class="board"></div><div class="ball hide" id="ball"></div><div class="cups" id="cups"></div></section><section class="score" id="score"></section><div class="setup" id="setup"><label>Spieler: <select id="playerCount"><option>2</option><option>3</option><option selected>4</option></select></label><label>Menschen: <select id="humanCount"><option>1</option><option selected>2</option><option>3</option><option>4</option></select></label></div><div class="controls"><button class="btn" id="start">Spiel starten</button><button class="btn hide" id="next">Nächste Runde</button><button class="btn hide" id="restart">Neues Spiel</button></div><div class="result hide" id="result"></div><p class="muted" id="help">Drei Runden · Jede Runde schneller und schwieriger · Wer die meisten Kugeln findet, gewinnt.</p></main><script>
(()=>{'use strict';const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));let players=[],round=0,secret=0,positions=[],cups=[],phase='setup',turn=0,token=0,answers=[],mixing=false,resizePending=false;const configs=[{n:3,swaps:8,ms:610,peek:1900},{n:4,swaps:13,ms:420,peek:1550},{n:5,swaps:19,ms:290,peek:1250}];$('bulbs').innerHTML=Array.from({length:13},()=>'<i></i>').join('');function safe(v){return String(v).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}function drawScore(){ $('score').innerHTML=players.map((p,i)=>`<div class="player ${phase==='guess'&&i===turn?'current':''}"><div class="name">${p.bot?'🤖':'👤'} ${safe(p.name)}</div><div class="points">${p.score} / ${round ? Math.min(3,round - (phase==='reveal'||phase==='done'?0:1)) : 0}</div><small>${phase==='guess'&&i===turn?'Jetzt auswählen':p.bot?'Computer':'Mensch'}</small></div>`).join('')}function msg(s){$('message').textContent=s}function width(){return $('cups').clientWidth}function coords(slot){let w=width();return {x:w*(.13+slot*.74/(configs[round-1].n-1)),y:$('cups').clientHeight*.77}}function place(el,slot){const c=coords(slot);el.style.left=c.x+'px';el.style.top=c.y+'px'}function makeCups(){const cfg=configs[round-1];positions=Array.from({length:cfg.n},(_,i)=>i);$('cups').innerHTML='';cups=positions.map((_,i)=>{let b=document.createElement('button');b.className='cup';b.innerHTML='<span class="shape"></span><span class="rim"></span>';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Hütchen '+(i+1));b.onclick=()=>pick(cups.indexOf(b));b.disabled=true;$('cups').append(b);place(b,i);return b});}function ballAt(slot){const c=coords(slot);$('ball').style.left=c.x+'px';$('ball').style.top=(c.y+46)+'px'}function swap(a,b,ms){return new Promise(resolve=>{mixing=true;const x=cups[a],y=cups[b];const startX=coords(a).x,endX=coords(b).x,baseY=coords(a).y;const start=performance.now();x.style.transition='none';y.style.transition='none';x.style.zIndex='6';y.style.zIndex='5';function frame(now){const t=Math.min(1,(now-start)/ms),e=t*t*(3-2*t);const currentWidth=width(),scale=currentWidth/(swapWidth||currentWidth);x.style.left=(startX+(endX-startX)*e)*scale+'px';y.style.left=(endX+(startX-endX)*e)*scale+'px';const rowY=coords(a).y;x.style.top=rowY+'px';y.style.top=rowY+'px';if(t<1){requestAnimationFrame(frame)}else{[cups[a],cups[b]]=[cups[b],cups[a]];[positions[a],positions[b]]=[positions[b],positions[a]];x.style.zIndex='';y.style.zIndex='';cups.forEach((cup,i)=>place(cup,i));mixing=false;resizePending=false;resolve()}}const swapWidth=width();requestAnimationFrame(frame)})}async function beginRound(){const id=++token;phase='show';answers=[];turn=0;const cfg=configs[round-1];$('roundLabel').textContent=`RUNDE ${round} / 3`;$('next').classList.add('hide');$('result').classList.add('hide');makeCups();$('stageInfo').textContent=`${cfg.n} Hütchen · ${cfg.swaps} Mischungen · ${['Einfach','Mittel','Schwer'][round-1]}`;secret=onlineSession?onlineSession.secret:Math.floor(Math.random()*cfg.n);ballAt(secret);$('ball').classList.remove('hide');cups[secret].style.transform='translate(-50%,-115%)';msg(`Runde ${round}: Schau genau hin! Unter diesem Hütchen liegt die leuchtende Kugel.`);drawScore();await sleep(cfg.peek);if(id!==token)return;cups[secret].style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%)';$('ball').classList.add('hide');await sleep(380);if(id!==token)return;phase='shuffle';msg('Augen auf! Die Hütchen werden gemischt …');for(let i=0;i<cfg.swaps;i++){let a,b;if(onlineSession){[a,b]=onlineSession.swaps[i]}else{a=Math.floor(Math.random()*cfg.n);do{b=Math.floor(Math.random()*cfg.n)}while(b===a)}await swap(a,b,cfg.ms);if(id!==token)return}phase='guess';turn=0;if(onlineSession){msg('Unter welchem Hütchen liegt die Kugel?');cups.forEach(c=>c.disabled=onlineSession.submitted);drawScore()}else promptTurn()}function promptTurn(){drawScore();if(turn>=players.length){finishRound();return}const p=players[turn];msg(`${p.name}: Unter welchem Hütchen liegt die Kugel?`);if(p.bot){cups.forEach(c=>c.disabled=true);const id=token;setTimeout(()=>{if(id!==token||phase!=='guess')return;const cfg=configs[round-1],accuracy=[.77,.62,.48][round-1];let guess;if(Math.random()<accuracy){guess=positions.indexOf(secret)}else{const wrong=positions.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>positions[i]!==secret);guess=wrong[Math.floor(Math.random()*wrong.length)]}record(guess)},850)}else{cups.forEach((c,i)=>{c.disabled=false;c.classList.remove('active');c.setAttribute('aria-label',`Hütchen ${i+1} auswählen`)})}}let onlineSession=null;
function onlinePick(i){
 if(!onlineSession||phase!=='guess'||onlineSession.submitted||!Number.isInteger(i)||i<0||i>=cups.length)return;
 onlineSession.submitted=true;
 cups.forEach(c=>c.disabled=true);
 msg('✓ Deine Antwort wurde gespeichert. Warte auf die Mitspieler.');
 window.parent.postMessage({type:'huetchen:answer',challengeId:onlineSession.challengeId,round:round,slot:i},location.origin);
}
function pick(i){if(onlineSession){onlinePick(i);return}if(phase!=='guess'||players[turn]?.bot)return;record(i)}function record(i){if(phase!=='guess'||i<0||i>=cups.length)return;answers.push({player:turn,slot:i,correct:positions[i]===secret});cups.forEach(c=>c.disabled=true);turn++;promptTurn()}function finishRound(){phase='reveal';let right=positions.indexOf(secret);ballAt(right);$('ball').classList.remove('hide');cups[right].style.transform='translate(-50%,-115%)';cups[right].classList.add('active');answers.forEach(a=>{if(a.correct)players[a.player].score++});drawScore();const good=answers.filter(a=>a.correct).map(a=>players[a.player].name);msg(good.length?'Runde '+round+' – richtig: '+good.join(', '):'Runde '+round+' – diesmal hat niemand richtig geraten!');if(round<3){$('next').classList.remove('hide')}else{phase='done';const max=Math.max(...players.map(p=>p.score)),winners=players.filter(p=>p.score===max);$('result').classList.remove('hide');$('result').innerHTML=`<h2>🏆 ${winners.length===1?safe(winners[0].name)+' gewinnt!':'Gleichstand: '+winners.map(p=>safe(p.name)).join(' & ')}</h2><p>${max} von 3 Runden richtig · ${winners.length>1?'Gemeinsamer Sieg bei gleicher Trefferzahl.':'Glückwunsch!'}</p>`;$('restart').classList.remove('hide');window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('huetchen:finished',{detail:window.HuetchenChallenge.getResult()}))}}function start(){++token;const count=+$('playerCount').value,humans=Math.min(count,+$('humanCount').value);players=Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>({name:i<humans?'Spieler '+(i+1):'Computer '+(i-humans+1),bot:i>=humans,score:0}));round=1;$('setup').classList.add('hide');$('start').classList.add('hide');$('restart').classList.add('hide');beginRound()}window.addEventListener('message',event=>{
 if(event.source!==window.parent||event.origin!==location.origin)return;
 const d=event.data;
 if(d?.type!=='huetchen:state')return;
 if(!Number.isInteger(d.round)||d.round<1||d.round>3||!Array.isArray(d.swaps))return;
 const cfg=configs[d.round-1];
 if(!Number.isInteger(d.secret)||d.secret<0||d.secret>=cfg.n||d.swaps.length!==cfg.swaps)return;
 if(!d.swaps.every(pair=>Array.isArray(pair)&&pair.length===2&&pair.every(n=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=0&&n<cfg.n)&&pair[0]!==pair[1]))return;
 if(onlineSession?.challengeId===d.challengeId&&onlineSession?.round===d.round){
  onlineSession.submitted=!!d.submitted;
  if(phase==='guess')cups.forEach(c=>c.disabled=onlineSession.submitted);
  return;
 }
 ++token;
 onlineSession={challengeId:d.challengeId,round:d.round,secret:d.secret,swaps:d.swaps,submitted:!!d.submitted};
 players=(d.players||[]).slice(0,4).map(p=>({name:String(p.name||'Spieler').slice(0,24),bot:false,score:Number(p.score)||0}));
 round=d.round;
 $('setup').classList.add('hide');$('start').classList.add('hide');$('restart').classList.add('hide');$('next').classList.add('hide');
 const serverOffset=Number(d.serverNow)-Date.now();
 const delay=Math.max(0,Number(d.startAt)-(Date.now()+serverOffset));
 const currentToken=token;
 msg('🎩 Bereit? Alle Spieler starten gemeinsam …');
 setTimeout(()=>{if(token===currentToken&&onlineSession?.challengeId===d.challengeId&&onlineSession.round===d.round)beginRound()},Math.min(delay,10000));
});
$('playerCount').onchange=()=>{const c=+$('playerCount').value;for(const o of $('humanCount').options)o.disabled=+o.value>c;if(+$('humanCount').value>c)$('humanCount').value=c};$('start').onclick=start;$('restart').onclick=start;$('next').onclick=()=>{if(phase==='reveal'&&round<3){round++;beginRound()}};window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!round||!cups.length)return;if(mixing){resizePending=true;return;}cups.forEach((c,i)=>place(c,i));if(phase==='show')ballAt(secret);if(phase==='reveal'||phase==='done')ballAt(positions.indexOf(secret))});window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(phase!=='guess'||players[turn]?.bot||e.repeat)return;const i=Number(e.key)-1;if(i>=0&&i<cups.length)pick(i)});window.HuetchenChallenge={startWithPlayers:(entries)=>{if(!Array.isArray(entries)||entries.length<2||entries.length>4)throw Error('2–4 Spieler erforderlich');++token;players=entries.map((p,i)=>({name:String(p.name||'Spieler '+(i+1)).slice(0,24),bot:!!p.bot,score:0}));round=1;$('setup').classList.add('hide');$('start').classList.add('hide');$('restart').classList.add('hide');beginRound()},getResult:()=>phase==='done'?{game:'huetchen-challenge',rounds:3,players:players.map(p=>({name:p.name,score:p.score,bot:p.bot})),winnerIndices:players.map((p,i)=>({p,i})).filter(x=>x.p.score===Math.max(...players.map(q=>q.score))).map(x=>x.i)}:null};})();
</script></body></html>
